answer: Each identity may endorse only 7 newcomers per epoch, and endorsement weight decays with graph distance from established roots, so a farm cannot bootstrap itself. 700 aliases need 700 genuine endorsements from distinct trusted branches, and a cluster that endorses only itself collapses to one share of emission. What carries the crystal here is verification, the harbor of cost is what stops the farm, and the beacon of the record keeps every claim checkable.
